theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_elc2_local_to_global_holder
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (U : Set (Rn n)), 0 < α → IsOpen U → (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (ball x r) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ ball x r, ∀ z ∈ ball x r, ‖fderiv ℝ f y - fderiv ℝ f z‖ ≤ C * ‖y - z‖ ^ α) → IsLocallyHolderCkα 1 α f U
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
